title: [Feature Request] Can you please bring in a battery status for OrangeLink into the Medtronic driver ?
body: Would be nice to see the status,  without disconnect OrangeLink in AAPS, scan it with nRF Connect to read the battery status, disconnect in nRF Connect and reconnect in AAPS again.

comments.body:
@Alamo04 At the moment if you enable battery display in settings, you can see battery level in "RileyLink Stats" dialog.

I will add display of battery level on main MDT tab too, with this ticket.

It's in the MDT tab, on the bottom right, circled here.
![Screenshot_20210317-165252.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1148665/111549242-76c24800-8741-11eb-931f-25482f24e773.png)

Oh god, never noticed this button. 🥴
Thanks @StephenBrown2

For me for a strange reason RL battery 🔋status on RL Stats is always 100% even after 2 weeks of continuous use. I no longer check it. Is there any way I can help to check the issue? I am using Energizer Lithium for my Orangelink.

@bchris21
Thats what Lithium batteries do. They lasts very long and hold their power over a long time.
But if they begin to drop their power, then it comes really fast to an end.

I read, that some have alkaline batteries in use and are still at 50% after 5 weeks.

So don't worry,  be happy.  😉
